title: [AI DRAFT] Off-spec batches are charted from the file, and the chart has the batches on it
rubric: Draws purity and moisture per batch in cells that read batches.csv with FileAttachment, with the limits of spec.md drawn as lines
The charts show the batches: a filter that keeps no rows (a parsed date compared with a string) leaves only the limit lines, which is the failure this case is for
Whatever period it reads 'this quarter' as, it says which, and a period holding no batches is said plainly, never shown as an empty chart
Over the whole file exactly three lots fail: B-2611 and B-2624 on purity, B-2619 on moisture; B-2605 (99.0) and B-2615 (0.50) sit on a limit and pass
The failing lots are listed by a cell that computes them, and no hand-typed table or prose repeats or contradicts it
Known gap: the runner never runs a cell, so it cannot see an empty chart; the app's own verdict does (docs/notebook-cells.md, the empty verdict), held by tests/integration/cell-verdict.test.ts
